class.name: SteamLobbyQuery
class.brief_description: Branchable options for a search within this game's Steam AppID and namespace.

method.name: on_map
method.description: Return a branch for the supplied world identifier. Steam discovery accepts up to 128 characters and 512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

method.name: with_room_for
method.description: Return a branch requiring one to 64 available lobby seats. The default is one.

method.name: within
method.description: Return a branch with the selected Steam region preference. The default is nearby.

method.name: limit
method.description: Return a branch capped at one to 50 results. The default is 20.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Start the search and await its typed result directly.

method.name: fetch_operation
method.description: Start the same search and retain an operation for cancellation or repeated reads. An overlapping SDK search returns busy.

method.name: social
method.description: Return a branch searching standalone social lobbies. Use a standalone [SteamLobbies] scope. Gameplay map filters do not apply to social searches.
